exam_guide_revision: Not a certification. Practical Python 3.10-3.14 fluency track; official Python documentation and selected AnyIO/HTTPX docs reviewed 2026-09-19.

learning_design.unlock_rule: A knowledge node unlocks after all required prompts are revealed.
learning_design.mastery_note: Discovery progress is not mastery evidence; progressively harder typed code recall provides the scored signal.

authoring_notes: Python Fluency is practical coding retrieval, not beginner trivia or a certification. Questions use progressive recall depth: guided -> recall -> construct -> fluency. Short literals stay on one line where readable, unfamiliar data shapes and intent are explained, and most questions have one meaningful blank.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________ copies important metadata from the wrapped function and exposes __wrapped__, making decorators friendlier to introspection and tooling.

reveal.text: functools.wraps copies important metadata from the wrapped function and exposes __wrapped__, making decorators friendlier to introspection and tooling.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ the inner wrapper with @wraps(func) before returning it.

reveal.text: Decorate the inner wrapper with @wraps(func) before returning it.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ wraps, decorated functions commonly appear to have the wrapper's name and docstring instead of the original function's metadata.

reveal.text: Without wraps, decorated functions commonly appear to have the wrapper's name and docstring instead of the original function's metadata.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________ memoizes calls without a size limit, while lru_cache(maxsize=...) bounds stored entries with least-recently-used eviction.

reveal.text: functools.cache memoizes calls without a size limit, while lru_cache(maxsize=...) bounds stored entries with least-recently-used eviction.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: @__________ is concise for pure computations with hashable arguments when unbounded growth is acceptable.

reveal.text: @cache is concise for pure computations with hashable arguments when unbounded growth is acceptable.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ arguments must be hashable, and caching functions with side effects or time-varying results can return stale behavior.

reveal.text: Cached arguments must be hashable, and caching functions with side effects or time-varying results can return stale behavior.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________ creates a new callable with selected positional or keyword arguments pre-filled.

reveal.text: functools.partial creates a new callable with selected positional or keyword arguments pre-filled.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ = partial(int, base=2) creates a one-argument binary parser.

reveal.text: parse_binary = partial(int, base=2) creates a one-argument binary parser.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ does not execute the function when it is created; it stores call configuration for later invocations.

reveal.text: partial does not execute the function when it is created; it stores call configuration for later invocations.

modules.title: Model data with dataclasses and enums

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________(default_factory=...) creates a fresh default value for each instance, avoiding shared mutable defaults.

reveal.text: dataclasses.field(default_factory=...) creates a fresh default value for each instance, avoiding shared mutable defaults.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) gives every instance its own list.

reveal.text: tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) gives every instance its own list.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ tags: list[str] = [] as a mutable dataclass default is rejected because instances must not accidentally share one list.

reveal.text: Using tags: list[str] = [] as a mutable dataclass default is rejected because instances must not accidentally share one list.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________(instance, **changes) creates another instance of the same dataclass while changing selected fields.

reveal.text: dataclasses.replace(instance, **changes) creates another instance of the same dataclass while changing selected fields.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ = replace(user, active=True) is a convenient immutable-style update.

reveal.text: updated = replace(user, active=True) is a convenient immutable-style update.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________() runs the generated __init__ and __post_init__ path; fields declared init=False have special restrictions.

reveal.text: replace() runs the generated __init__ and __post_init__ path; fields declared init=False have special restrictions.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________() asks the Enum machinery to generate a member value; the generated value depends on the enum type and _generate_next_value_.

reveal.text: enum.auto() asks the Enum machinery to generate a member value; the generated value depends on the enum type and _generate_next_value_.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ StrEnum, auto() produces the lower-cased member name.

reveal.text: For StrEnum, auto() produces the lower-cased member name.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ not assume auto() always produces integers; specialized Enum types can define different generated values.

reveal.text: Do not assume auto() always produces integers; specialized Enum types can define different generated values.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: @__________ turns a generator function with exactly one yield into a context manager whose setup runs before yield and cleanup runs afterward.

reveal.text: @contextmanager turns a generator function with exactly one yield into a context manager whose setup runs before yield and cleanup runs afterward.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ try/finally around yield when cleanup must happen even if the with-body raises.

reveal.text: Use try/finally around yield when cleanup must happen even if the with-body raises.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ contextmanager generator must yield exactly once; forgetting yield or yielding multiple times breaks the protocol.

reveal.text: A contextmanager generator must yield exactly once; forgetting yield or yielding multiple times breaks the protocol.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________(*exceptions) is a small context manager for intentionally ignoring specific exception types around a narrow operation.

reveal.text: contextlib.suppress(*exceptions) is a small context manager for intentionally ignoring specific exception types around a narrow operation.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ suppress(FileNotFoundError): path.unlink() expresses that a missing file is acceptable.

reveal.text: with suppress(FileNotFoundError): path.unlink() expresses that a missing file is acceptable.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ suppress scopes narrow; broad exception suppression can hide programming errors and make failures difficult to diagnose.

reveal.text: Keep suppress scopes narrow; broad exception suppression can hide programming errors and make failures difficult to diagnose.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: __________ returns a context manager that performs no setup or cleanup, useful when code conditionally needs a real context manager.

reveal.text: contextlib.nullcontext returns a context manager that performs no setup or cleanup, useful when code conditionally needs a real context manager.

prompts.label: ⌨️ CODE?
prompts.placeholder: __________ = open(path) if path else nullcontext(sys.stdin) lets one with-statement handle owned and borrowed resources.

reveal.text: cm = open(path) if path else nullcontext(sys.stdin) lets one with-statement handle owned and borrowed resources.

prompts.label: ⚠️ GOTCHA
prompts.placeholder: __________ does not close or otherwise manage the object you pass as enter_result.

reveal.text: nullcontext does not close or otherwise manage the object you pass as enter_result.
